passages.note: Co-sponsorship of HB2853, but this act is from Kavanagh's 2022 House service, before the Senate term (2023-01-02-present) being coded.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Enacted text extends ESA eligibility to any student eligible to enroll in public school, matching a universal-voucher provision, but the enactment predates and is from outside the Senate term being coded.
Kavanagh voted Y on House Third Reading of HB2853, but as a member of the House in 2022, not during the Senate term being coded.

rows.reasoning: All three passages concern HB2853 (2022), which Kavanagh co-sponsored and voted for as a member of the Arizona House, dated June-July 2022 -- before and in a different office than the State Senate term (2023-01-02-present) being coded here. Per V5, a record from an earlier office is valid for that office only, so none of these passages can establish a chair for this Senate row even though the enacted text matches "funding follows the student to any school ... chosen by the family."
